remarks: A one-of-a-kind home in the community: this corner-unit, two-story residence offers 3 bedrooms, 2 fully remodeled bathrooms and added privacy. Updated flooring runs throughout a bright, open layout, with bedrooms upstairs for separation of living and sleeping space. Step outside to a private backyard and patio, a rare find in the community and ideal for morning coffee, weekend grilling or quiet evenings. A two-car garage gives you room for vehicles, storage and gear. You'll be minutes from Irvine Spectrum and Foothill Ranch Towne Centre for shopping, dining and entertainment, with Whiting Ranch trails and I-5/241 access nearby. Homes like this don't come along often.
